create_Gemma3nForConditionalGeneration: create a Gemma3nForConditionalGeneration model with config and optional quant_config for multimodal generation
build_Gemma3nMultimodalEmbedder: build a Gemma3nMultimodalEmbedder to project multimodal embeddings into language model space
run_Gemma3nMultimodalEmbedder_forward: run Gemma3nMultimodalEmbedder forward with input_ids or inputs_embeds to get normalized embeddings
get_Gemma3n_image_feature: get image features from pixel values using the vision tower and embed them into language model space
get_Gemma3n_audio_feature: get audio features from input features using the audio encoder and embed them into language model space
